title: BASIC# Release Package Preflight
purpose: Verify the active changed-files manifest, installed tree bytes, release identity, validation inventory inclusion, and package acceptance records before a candidate release package enters acceptance testing.
forbidden: accepting a release package whose final extracted payload has not been audited
changing sealed validation inventory after package records are generated
repairing only the first failed deterministic fixture hash
removing the DKLab compatibility bridge in v0.1.66
